title: Scout on a diet
intro: Llama 4 Scout has 109B parameters. BF16 needs 2 bytes per parameter; INT4 needs half a byte.
prompt: Roughly how many GB do Scout's weights need at 4-bit?

live.label: 80-GB GPUs just to load your guess

debrief: 109B × 0.5 bytes ≈ **55 GB** — from 3 GPUs (220 GB at BF16) down to **one 80-GB card**, with room left for cache. Caveat from the lab: small models fall short of the theoretical 4× (Qwen3-0.6B measured −42%, not −75%) because the LM head and norms stay high-precision; big models get close.
